Published hand and PCD50 reference housing meshes. The upstream housing is not a complete ES-062 electronics model.

representation.note: Public reference meshes with the retained Botrail r2 parallel-motion joint tree and teaching TCP. The mounting housing carries the PCD50 robot-side pattern and four hand-side axes. Electronics, spring contacts, cable, protector and mounting hardware are BOM-only; do not infer their clearance or contact behavior. Physical axial seating, calibrated TCP, adaptive contact motion and actuator limits remain unverified. Previous manufacturer-CAD overlap volumes and contact travel checks do not apply to this representation. Manufacturer support describes the documented purchased ES-062 kit, independently of mesh precision.
